podcast.title: Founder of Gibson Company
podcast.body: Orville Gibson founded his company in Kalamazoo, Michigan in 1894. The company initially manufactured mandolins before he innovated guitar design. "Orville Gibson founded his company in Kalamazoo, Michigan in 1894, the first factory manufactured Mandalins."

srcs.source: The Ongoing History of New Music

podcast.title: Inventor of the Archtop Guitar
podcast.body: Orville Gibson invented the Archtop guitar, which features a slight arch or curve on the front of the guitar's body. He derived this design principle from the construction of violins. "Orville then invented the Archtop guitar. This means the front of the guitar's body has a slight arch accurve to it. Orville got this idea from how violins are constructed."

srcs.source: The Ongoing History of New Music
